items.headline: Anthropic hands its "Agent Skills" standard to the Linux Foundation
items.summary: Agent Skills are the packaged instructions that teach an AI assistant how to do a specific job, like Claude's Skills. Anthropic donated the standard to the Agentic AI Foundation, a neutral group under the Linux Foundation, so no single company controls it. More than 70 AI platforms already support it.
items.why_it_matters: A skill you build once for Claude should keep working across more tools over time, so the time you put into custom skills is a safer bet.
